device_name: ORBIT GALAXY G2 MICROCOIL DELIVERY SYSTEM
device_name_fda: ORBIT GALAXY G2 MICROCOIL DELIVERY SYSTEM
what_it_is: Coil has a unique ability to seek out and fill the open spaces in an aneurysm, enabling greater packing density
sizing_specs: Materials: Bare platinum, polypropylene stretch-resistant suture
indications: Indicated for embolizing intracranial aneurysms; indicated for embolizing intracranial aneurysms, AVMs, and AV fistulas; embolization of peripheral vasculature
use_notes:
Method of Detachment: Hydraulic detachment
Coil Type: Complex framing, filling, and finishing coils

[FDA RECALL] 1 active recall(s).
  - Detachable coils system may fail to detach, which could result in hemorrhagic and ischemic stroke, procedural delays, or the need for additional surgical intervention.
